subject: technology
title: Computational Thinking and Problem Decomposition
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Algorithms and Programming
essential_question: What makes a problem solvable by a computer, and how do we know our plan works before we build it?
performance_task: Design and hand-trace an algorithm for a defined user need, documenting decomposition and abstraction choices.

subject: technology
title: Programming Foundations: Data, Control, and Functions
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Algorithms and Programming
essential_question: How do a few control structures and well-chosen data combine into a program that solves a real problem?
topics: iteration nested loops and loop conditions
functions parameters return values and composition
performance_task: Build a modular program that uses compound conditions, nested iteration, and composed functions to solve a stated problem for a real user.

subject: technology
title: Debugging, Testing, and Version Control
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Algorithms and Programming
essential_question: Why does correct-looking code fail, and what evidence proves it is actually fixed?
topics: test case design and edge cases
performance_task: Repair a supplied defective program and deliver a commit history, a defect log, a failing test that reproduces the bug, and a verified fix.

subject: technology
title: Computing Systems, Hardware, and Abstraction
essential_question: What is actually happening beneath the interface, and why does the abstraction matter?
performance_task: Diagram a computing system across its abstraction layers and document a reproducible troubleshooting protocol.

subject: technology
title: Human-Centered and Accessible Interface Design
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Impacts of Computing
essential_question: Who is excluded by a design, and how do we find out before we ship it?
topics: forms validation and error handling without private data
usability testing consent and inclusive tradeoffs
performance_task: Build a responsive, accessible multi-view interface with validated forms, then document an accessibility audit and a user-test revision log.

subject: technology
title: Foundations Project and Impact Review
standards: Michigan Computer Science: Algorithms and Programming
essential_question: What evidence should accompany software before anyone else relies on it?
topics: version control and iterative build history
privacy security and data minimization review
performance_task: Deliver a foundations software project with version history, test evidence, an accessibility audit, and a privacy and security review.
